import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click on the Orders link to navigate to the Orders page
    orders_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Orders')
    await orders_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Optional: add a small sleep to ensure content is fully rendered
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
